summary: This is a routine earnings release (1Q26) filed by Sabesp on Form 6-K. It provides financial results: adjusted EPS R$0.44, adjusted EBITDA R$3.8 billion (+26% y/y), and capex of R$3.7 billion (+31% y/y). There is no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation disclosed. The filing is a standard quarterly update, not a special-situations event. As a Brazilian company, the 6-K serves as the equivalent of an earnings press release under US reporting rules; no actionable deal terms or corporate action are present.
